notes:
Summary: Frugalist CX is a mid-market e-commerce support platform focused on maximizing chat deflection and minimizing per-ticket spend. High-volume, low-margin support environment: ~25k messages/hour currently across NA and EU, expected 3x during holiday spikes. Primary asks: sub-$0.03 cost-per-resolved-ticket, median suggestion latency <300ms for inline agent assist, deterministic behavior during burst windows.

Recent conversations / quotes: 
- "We need to hold costs or this never passes procurement." (Sr. Head of Support)
- "If suggestions take >300ms agents will ignore them — adoption drops off." (Lead Support Ops)
- "Show us a POC that proves 40% chat deflection with < $0.03 ticket cost and comparable NPS"

Technical priorities: batching/caching, aggressive KV prefix cache for common flows, quantized model options (8-bit/4-bit) for both hosted and dedicated, top-k model routing to fallback cheaper model variants during spikes, per-customer token accounting. Also require tooling for cost forecasting and token-level visibility.

POC scope agreed: 
- Run 2-week A/B with Redwood Hosted vs their current self-hosted microservice (baseline) 
- Measure: deflection rate, tokens-per-resolved-ticket, median latency (in-app suggestion), 95th pct latency during spikes, end-to-end agent handoff time. 
- Data: anonymized transcript set (drive link above). 

Security / compliance notes: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for staff, KMS for customer secrets, data residency for EU customers — procurement flagged private deployment if residency cannot be guaranteed on hosted tier.

Operational concerns / risks: 
- Burst reliability: Black Friday-like spikes cause queueing and timeouts in current infra. Will want canary fallback rules and model routing.
- Cost model sensitivity: small token-cost changes materially change ROI. Need Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization profiles.
- Integration: wants lightweight webhook tool-calling for CRM updates and single-sign on for support agents.

Attachments & refs: pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ (drive link), Fireflies call transcripts (ids above), Jira tickets for integration requirements (AI-2345, OPS-6892).

Sales notes / shorthand: 
- AE: Ava leading exec sponsor calls. 
- SE: Diego to run benchmark scripts and quantization tests. 
- Next: Redwood to deliver hosted cost-per-ticket projection + small canary config for spike protection by 2026-03-18.
- Procurement: legal has initial SLA asks; awaiting SOC2 report and data residency confirmation.
